item.title: 【Interviews / TV shows / Others】PACK - I Dream Series (2004) DVDRIP
item.description:
PLEASE READ :

This is my first share, the full rip of 2004 I Dream series.
There's releases of this one.
First is the Australian one (that only contains the first 4 episodes)
Second one is the French release, higher quality than the AUS one, BUT dubbed in french, but also, the full series.
So i took the original rip from back in the day and replace the audio on the french release.
Only thing is that the songs are subtitled in french.
But you will get the full 13 episodes.
I want it to share it with the hope that someone can upscale the full series (which i love)

Enjoy!
(If someone wants to upload it in another server please go)
